layers.name: Silicon substrate
layers.info: Thinned bulk silicon that carries the circuits. In the package it faces up toward the cooler. Thickness approximate.

layers.name: Transistor layer
layers.info: 45.6 billion FinFET transistors in a sheet thinner than a hair (drawn far thicker than real).

layers.name: Local wiring
layers.info: Finest copper lines linking neighbouring transistors. Metal layer count and pitches are not published; approximate.

layers.name: Intermediate wiring
layers.info: Wider lines connecting blocks such as SMs to the L2 cache.

layers.name: Global wiring
layers.info: Thick top metal for power distribution and long-distance signals across the die.

layers.name: Pads
layers.info: Landing pads where the C4 bumps join the package. One row drawn.

layers.name: Floorplan
layers.info: Rough block layout of the full GB203, seen through the stack. Block positions and sizes are illustrative, not traced from a die shot; the counts are real.

parts.name: GPCs (row 1)
parts.info: Graphics Processing Cluster: raster engine plus 6 TPCs of 2 SMs each. The 5070 Ti fuses off one whole GPC and one more TPC (70 of 84 SMs); which ones varies per chip and is not published.

parts.name: GPCs (row 2)
parts.info: Graphics Processing Cluster: raster engine plus 6 TPCs of 2 SMs each. The 5070 Ti fuses off one whole GPC and one more TPC (70 of 84 SMs); which ones varies per chip and is not published.

parts.name: L2 cache
parts.info: Shared L2 cache between the GPCs and the memory controllers. On the 5070 Ti, 48 of the 64 MB are enabled.

parts.name: Memory controllers (left)
parts.info: 32-bit GDDR7 controller and PHY at the die edge, each driving one memory chip. Edge placement approximate.

parts.name: Memory controllers (right)
parts.info: 32-bit GDDR7 controller and PHY at the die edge, each driving one memory chip. Edge placement approximate.

parts.name: PCIe, display and media engines
parts.info: PCIe 5.0 x16 interface, display engine (DisplayPort 2.1b / HDMI 2.1b) and video encode/decode. Grouped into one block; position approximate.
